procedure.method: Fresh independent portfolio review with no spawn, fork or resume and no peer/producer/planner record inspection. Read the pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, addendum and method; verified declared bytes/hashes and read all five pinned native-evidence manifests without following their embedded paths. Packet source_assets and protected_layouts are explicitly empty, so there were no source-asset opens or protected-layout reads. Actually opened and saw each exact image using functions.exec with tools.view_image(detail=original), emitting the returned image: M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2 in the same three-view order, then M3, M4 and M5. All fifteen image displays completed before starting the first text-reading/transcription stage or any judgment or score. Raw strings below are first readings from those displayed pixels, with layout wrapping retained and no copy inferred from required text. No ambiguity-triggered revisits were needed. PNG headers were separately checked for packet dimensions and RGB opacity; hash/header verification was not treated as semantic viewing. No runtime session ID or serialized opening event is claimed.
